product.title: Pella® 250 Series Vinyl Single-Hung Window
product.description: Single-hung windows feature a bottom sash that opens and closes for ventilation, and a top sash that remains stationary. With smart, energy-efficient choices and the most features and options of our vinyl products, Pella 250 Series single-hung windows are the perfect addition to your home.

specs.name: STC
specs.value: 25 for dual-pane windows; 28 for triple-pane windows

specs.name: Frame construction
specs.value: Frame members are mitered and heat fused to provide a fully welded corner assembly.

specs.name: Sash construction
specs.value: Sash members are extruded, rigid PVC, and are mitered and heat-fused to provide a fully welded corner assembly.

specs.name: Sash lift
specs.value: Includes an integral extruded sash lift as standard.

specs.name: Weatherstripping
specs.value: Sash is weatherstripped around the sash perimeter with a fin-type, pile weatherstripping and vinyl wrapped foam weatherstrip.

specs.name: Glass quality
specs.value: Quality float glass complying with AS™ C 1036.

features: Pella's precision welding process creates more durable products that resist warping or twisting over time and are 52% stronger than ordinary vinyl.
Available in sizes from 14-1/2" x 23-1/2” to 53-1/2” x 77-1/2”.
Popular configurations include arch head, springline, partial arch head and partial springline configurations.
Select combinations are available for online purchase.
